proposedOperatorData.name: Zip World
proposedOperatorData.tagline: Home of the world's fastest zip line, across former Welsh slate quarries and caverns
proposedOperatorData.description:
Zip World is a North Wales-founded adventure tourism company established in 2013 by ex-Royal Marines commando Sean Taylor, growing out of his earlier Treetop Adventures (2007) near Betws-y-Coed. It repurposes historic Welsh industrial sites — slate quarries, caverns and a former colliery — into large-scale adventure attractions. In January 2025 Dolphin Capital acquired a majority stake for a reported £100 million, with Taylor retaining a minority share.

Its flagship site, Zip World Penrhyn Quarry near Bethesda, is home to Velocity 2, marketed as the world's fastest and Europe's longest zip line, reaching over 100mph head-first above a quarry lake; the site also offers off-road Quarry Karts and quarry tours. At Zip World Llechwedd in Blaenau Ffestiniog, Bounce Below suspends giant trampoline nets inside a slate cavern, alongside the underground Titan zip line, deep mine tours and the world's first underground golf course. Zip World Fforest near Betws-y-Coed adds a forest coaster and the Skyride giant swing.

Most sites sit within or adjacent to Eryri (Snowdonia) National Park; a separate South Wales site, Zip World Tower, operates at the former Tower Colliery at Rhigos in Rhondda Cynon Taf.
